messages:
Sara: Heads-up: p99 tail spiked after the v2.3 runtime rollout in canary around 10:15 UTC — customer-facing requests hitting ~1.8s vs baseline ~1.0s. Support ticket #4347 escalated. Anyone oncall? :rotating_light:
Jonathan: I'm oncall. Confirming we see p95 ~+40ms, p99 ~+800ms for the canary cohort. Grafana panels look bad: https://grafana.redwood/example . Can we check whether these are long-context requests or short ones?
Sara: Support says mostly short prompts (<=128 tokens). Traffic mix and QPS same as yesterday. Canary traffic is 5% in region-us-west.
Kevin: I shipped a kernel-selector tweak in this rollout that biases for locality kernels on small sequences. I can revert the change if we think it's the cause. :thinking_face:
Anya: We should bisect by toggling the selector flag in canary first rather than full rollback. I'll flip the feature flag 10%->0% for canary and watch.
Jonathan: Also please capture traces for any requests >1s. Create a trace id and attach. We need kv-cache hit rates, RPC latencies, and per-host tail logs.
deploybot: Deploybot: rollout v2.3 completed for canary at 2025-11-12T10:12:34Z
Sara: Customer reports 8 errors / 1000 and noticeable lag during peak. They're asking for ETA on mitigation — support wants a short blurb to send.
Anya: Toggling kernel-selector OFF in canary now. Command used: `./feature-toggle set runtime.kernel_selector=false --env=canary --pct=100` — monitoring :eyes:
Lucas: Quick signal: within 5m p99 dropped from ~1.8s -> ~1.05s, p95 unchanged. Looks like the kernel-selector change correlated with the tail.
Sara: Good catch. Can we prepare a rollback plan for v2.3 and patch the kernel-selector change? Support will tell the customer we mitigated and are working on root cause.
Kevin: Opening a bug and postmortem item: kernel-selector optimization regressed small-sequence latency. Action items: stricter microbench for <=128 tokens, add unit perf test, and prevent selector flip in canary without short-context perf validation.
Jonathan: Follow-ups assigned: Kevin (root cause & PR), Anya (rollback playbook + toggle runbook), Lucas (verify canary -> staging gating), Sara (customer comms). I'll keep the thread for status.
supportbot: Supportbot: ticket #4347 updated — customer notified of mitigation and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:
